body_html:
This article by @mikepenn makes so little sense. First all evidence is pointing to the Leaked questions coming from the White House and not Mueller.

Second investigators ask the questions. That is what it means to investigate.

Notice question one: "zero donors" no longer saying zero Republicans....because well you know selective facts.

Question two: Lisa Page and Peter Strzok texts? Aren't FBI agents private and political communications protected by law? That isn't how "poisonous tree" works. No search was deemed illegal.

Question three: Really going to attack Mueller's objectivity?

Question eight: Manafort raid. Didn't a judge say there is enough evidence that life in prison is a possibility? The word gunpoint is loaded. Every FBI officer has a firearm.

Question nine: Whitey Bulger??? You for real. Go watch Departed

Question ten: Steel Dossier? Isn't well documented that Papadapoulous got the ball rolling?

Question eleven: Secretly obtained? You mean by warrant.

it just goes on and on.
